points.description: States that a queue is a data structure (or a collection/structure) that stores elements. Equivalent wording such as 'a way of storing data items' earns the mark.

States that the queue follows the first in, first out (FIFO) principle, i.e. the first element added is the first one removed. Equivalent wording such as 'first come, first served' or 'the oldest element leaves first' earns the mark.
Names the two main queue operations: enqueue (adding an element to the back/rear) and dequeue (removing an element from the front). Naming both earns full marks; naming only one earns partial credit.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for naming one of the two operations (enqueue or dequeue) without the other. Descriptions of what each operation does are not required, though correct descriptions are acceptable.
